releases.text: Voxtral 3: Mistral's voice agent SDK für Echtzeit-Sprache in 50+ Sprachen, genaue Transkription, emotionales TTS, tiefgreifende Tool-Nutzung.
releases.text_en: Voxtral 3: Mistral's voice agent SDK for real-time speech in 50+ languages, accurate transcription, emotional TTS, deep tool use.

x_analysen.text: Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 takes the #3 spot on the Artificial Analysis Speech to Text leaderboard with a 2.1% AA-WER Index, ahead of ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (2.2%) and Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 (2.3%)
Voxtral 3 TTS generates 112.3 characters per second, faster than Eleven v4 Turbo at 78.1
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 costs $0.42 per task, more than 2x MiMo-V2.6-Pro (56%) at $0.18 per task but 4x cheaper than GPT-6 Sol (Daybreak Blue, max, 69%) at $1.77 per task
